published_evidence.exploitation_evidence: The attacker transferred the balances of the two tokenIds and stole the rewards from the contract multiple times by repeatedly claiming the rewards.
published_evidence.fix_strategy_evidence: Update the variables lastClaimTotalRewards and timeClaimed before the feeClaimable check.
published_evidence.root_cause_evidence: lastClaimTotalRewards only updates when feeClaimable is greater than 0.
